Applying Cyclical Learning Rate (CLR) has positive impacts on Neural Machine Translation (NMT) training for both Adam and SGD optimizers. For SGD, CLR allows for better exploration of local minima without needing a large initial learning rate, while for Adam, CLR consistently improves performance regardless of shrink options.
